OpenAI 与 Google Cloud⁠（在新窗口打开） 达成合作，将 OpenAI 的前沿模型和 Codex⁠（在新窗口打开） 智能体工作流引入 Google Cloud 的 Model Garden。此次集成将使客户能够原生访问这些模型，以大规模驱动复杂的智能体工作流，并依托 Google Cloud 的数据治理和高性能基础设施。

inlines.text: 达成合作，将 OpenAI 的前沿模型和
智能体工作流引入 Google Cloud 的 Model Garden。此次集成将使客户能够原生访问这些模型，以大规模驱动复杂的智能体工作流，并依托 Google Cloud 的数据治理和高性能基础设施。

blocks.text: Google Cloud 长期以来在机器学习和 AI 领域的投入，使其成为 AI 工作负载以及构建这些工作负载的开发者和数据科学家的首选之地。将 OpenAI 模型引入其模型花园，使这些团队能够在他们已熟悉的环境中访问 OpenAI 的前沿模型，帮助企业实现软件开发生命周期的现代化、构建智能体工作流，并改变人们的工作方式。

inlines.text: Google Cloud 长期以来在机器学习和 AI 领域的投入，使其成为 AI 工作负载以及构建这些工作负载的开发者和数据科学家的首选之地。将 OpenAI 模型引入其模型花园，使这些团队能够在他们已熟悉的环境中访问 OpenAI 的前沿模型，帮助企业实现软件开发生命周期的现代化、构建智能体工作流，并改变人们的工作方式。

blocks.text: 对于受监管行业中的组织而言，部署 AI 需要控制谁可以访问敏感数据以及如何使用这些数据。此次集成将把 OpenAI 的前沿模型与 Google Cloud 内置的访问控制、集中式数据治理和高性能基础设施相结合，以支持要求严苛的企业工作负载。

inlines.text: 对于受监管行业中的组织而言，部署 AI 需要控制谁可以访问敏感数据以及如何使用这些数据。此次集成将把 OpenAI 的前沿模型与 Google Cloud 内置的访问控制、集中式数据治理和高性能基础设施相结合，以支持要求严苛的企业工作负载。

blocks.text: Google Cloud 客户将能够通过模型花园购买 OpenAI 前沿模型，并通过 Google Cloud Marketplace 进行交易。拥有 Google Cloud 支出承诺的企业将能够从这些购买中抵扣其 GCP 承诺额度。

blocks.text: 此外，OpenAI 模型很快将在 Google Antigravity 和 Gemini Agent 中提供，为企业客户提供模型选择的灵活性，并为每项任务选用最佳模型。通过 Google Cloud 扩大访问范围，我们正在为企业提供更多选择，让他们能够发现和使用前沿模型，并拥有一条从评估到更广泛采用的路径。

blocks.text: “Google Cloud 是开发者和企业构建 AI 智能体、编写软件并将 AI 投入应用的领先平台。此次合作是重要的一步，使我们最强大的模型和 Codex 能够在客户已经开展构建的地方提供，让他们在使用前沿 AI 方面拥有更多选择，同时我们共同发展智能体生态系统。”
—Greg Brockman，OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人

OpenAI and Google Cloud⁠(opens in a new window) are partnering to bring OpenAI’s frontier models and Codex⁠(opens in a new window) agentic workflows into Google Cloud’s Model Garden. The integration will give customers native access to these models to power complex agentic workflows at scale, backed by Google Cloud’s data governance and high-performance infrastructure.

inlines.text: Google Cloud⁠(opens in a new window)
are partnering to bring OpenAI’s frontier models and

agentic workflows into Google Cloud’s Model Garden. The integration will give customers native access to these models to power complex agentic workflows at scale, backed by Google Cloud’s data governance and high-performance infrastructure.

blocks.text: Google Cloud’s longstanding investment in machine learning and AI has made it a destination for AI workloads and the developers and data scientists building them. Bringing OpenAI models to its model garden gives these teams access to OpenAI’s frontier models within the environment where they already work, enabling enterprises to modernize their software development lifecycle, build agentic workflows, and change how people work.

inlines.text: Google Cloud’s longstanding investment in machine learning and AI has made it a destination for AI workloads and the developers and data scientists building them. Bringing OpenAI models to its model garden gives these teams access to OpenAI’s frontier models within the environment where they already work, enabling enterprises to modernize their software development lifecycle, build agentic workflows, and change how people work.

blocks.text: For organizations in regulated industries, deploying AI requires control over who can access sensitive data and how it is used. The integration will pair OpenAI’s frontier models with Google Cloud’s built-in access controls, centralized data governance, and high-performance infrastructure to support demanding enterprise workloads.

inlines.text: For organizations in regulated industries, deploying AI requires control over who can access sensitive data and how it is used. The integration will pair OpenAI’s frontier models with Google Cloud’s built-in access controls, centralized data governance, and high-performance infrastructure to support demanding enterprise workloads.

blocks.text: Google Cloud customers will be able to purchase OpenAI frontier models via model garden, transacted through the Google Cloud Marketplace. Enterprises with Google Cloud spend commitments will be able to draw down their GCP commitments for these purchases.

inlines.text: Google Cloud customers will be able to purchase OpenAI frontier models via model garden, transacted through the Google Cloud Marketplace. Enterprises with Google Cloud spend commitments will be able to draw down their GCP commitments for these purchases.

blocks.text: Additionally, OpenAI models will soon be available in Google Antigravity and the Gemini Agent, providing enterprise customers with model choice flexibility and the best model for each task. By expanding access through Google Cloud, we are giving enterprises greater choice in how they discover and use frontier models, with a path from evaluation to broader adoption.

blocks.text: “Google Cloud is a leading platform for developers and businesses building AI agents, writing software, and putting AI to work. This partnership is an important step in making our most capable models and Codex available where customers are already building, giving them even more choice in how they use frontier AI as we grow the agentic ecosystem together.”
—Greg Brockman, President and co-founder, OpenAI

“We are focused on giving customers a broad selection of models, including those from OpenAI, so they can choose the right model for any given job, helping to deliver optimal quality and lower costs.”
—Thomas Kurian, Chief Executive Officer, Google Cloud
